What competitors have our prospects mentioned? (List each competitor and how often / in what context.) 3. What objections have the prospects raised? (List each objection and how often it appeared.) 4. Did our sales reps ask the following sales qualifying questions? They may not use these exact words — recognise paraphrases and equivalent phrasing: - "How many extensions or users do you need?" - "What's your current provider?" - "Do you require deskphones or just softphone apps to make and receive calls?" - "Do you use any sort of CRM system in your business?" For each of the four questions, report how many / which calls it was asked in and give an overall coverage rate (e.g. asked in X of Y relevant calls). Flag calls where important qualifying questions were missed. Start the report with a short executive summary. Be specific and base everything strictly on the provided data — do not invent details. If the data set is empty, say clearly that no calls were found for the period.

parameters.content:
## Get a periodic call analysis report from NUACOM calls

### How it works
1. Every selected period (here weekly), the workflow analyzes calls in NUACOM
2. AI gets the calls and scores them acting as a sales manager and trying to get information about pains, issues in selling and general data of the call.
3. Once the analysis is completed, it sends the result to an email with Gmail.
### Setup steps
1. Set up the trigger by selecting when this workflow you need to excecute.
2. Enable AI call analysis in NUACOM to get the summary and the transcription of the call automatically.
3. Get and filter a specific number of extensions or numbers to get the call data from.
4. Set the prompt for the AI agent to score the call based on your requirements.
5. Declare the email where this report need to get delivered to.


### Customization
You can customise the workflow by:
1. Taking out the filter for specific numbers or checking for all NUACOM calls.
2. Changing the AI agent scoring behavior.
3. Deliver the report to a document, 3rd party system like CRMs instead of an email.

## Main Trigger setup

Here you set the time/period you want this workflow to run automatically.

## Getting calls from NUACOM

Here you set which calls you need to take into consideration. You can selecte specific numbers or extensions. You can also filter out calls with small duration to have a better report results.

## AI Setup

Here you prepare the data to get fed on the AI agent. In our example we kept specific data from the call. Also in thi step you can set the behavior and the scoring settings of the AI agent that will analyze the call.

## Receive the results

In the last step you setup where the results need to get delivered. In this example we have chosen over Email using Gmail.
